diagnosis.source_observation: The production grouped IQ4 down shape is K=512, hence only 16 32-value subblocks. The old local128 kernel populated lanes 0-15 and reduced three all-zero waves; qwen-kernel@52e240f9 uses local32 for the analogous grouped IQ4 down shader.
diagnosis.rejected_predecessor: The earlier exact output-tile-2 experiment raised VGPR 64->104 and regressed matched leaf time by about 50%; it was removed and was not repeated.

change.summary: Specialize exact grouped IQ4 down at K=512 to one wave while retaining the local128 general-shape key as fallback.
change.exactness: Lanes 0-15 retain the same IQ4 segment dot and wave32 shuffle tree. The removed waves were identically +0.0 at K=512; thread 0 retains the old +0.0-initialized cross-wave accumulation boundary before BF16 storage.
change.fallback: The auto four-axis key selects wave32 only at K=512 and delegates other shapes to selected_grouped_prefill_compact_bf16_bf16_out; direct selected-single remains the unfused fallback.

red_green.primitive_red: Importing the missing K512 wave32 wrapper failed test collection before the kernel/key existed.
red_green.dispatch_red: The compact-MoE routing fixture registered only the new policy key while runtime still requested local128, forcing the route to fall through and fail.
red_green.green: The auto key resolves, selects the K512 wave32 leaf, retains local128 at K=1024, and matches both fallbacks bit-for-bit.
